dedupe_keys.name: c town and anytown water distribution datasets generated with dhalsim

description: The DHALSIM team produced these two simulated datasets of benchmark water distribution systems, C-Town and Anytown, run with the DHALSIM hybrid simulator under normal operation, network anomalies and cyber attacks. Each holds ground truth physical data and SCADA data, captures of the simulated control network, and all configuration files needed to reproduce the runs; version 1.1 of C-Town added router network data and fixed some SCADA data. Coverage is the two benchmark networks, not real systems. The datasets are a free download from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 (C-Town 8.1 GB, Anytown 900.7 MB), and DHALSIM is on GitHub. Caveats: the data are simulations, and users are asked to cite the accompanying paper. Simulation uses: training and testing attack and anomaly detection and cyber-physical digital twins of water networks. Related records: the BATADAL datasets (data-batadal-attack-detection-datasets) and EPANET (model-epanet).
